brief:
Settlers attacked Mugheir village northeast of Ramallah on Sunday evening, according to Shehab Wire, with Israeli occupation forces providing armed protection during the assault. The raid marked the latest in a series of incidents targeting Palestinian communities in the area surrounding the northern reaches of the West Bank city.

During the operation, Israeli forces detained two young men from the village. The circumstances surrounding their arrest and the specific demands or actions that preceded the detention remain unclear. Such settler attacks, typically conducted under military escort, have become recurring flashpoints in villages across the occupied territory, particularly in areas near major Palestinian population centers.
title: Settlers attack Mugheir village north of Ramallah with Israeli military support
